items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The guy that was playing along with me was Wingy Manone.

ctx.x: Yes, it was. She was gorgeous. Anyway, when Jackie Gleason and all that bunch started coming in, the manager, Billy Berg, started saying why didn't I book you guys here before, and we started loading them then with movie stars; Lena Horne, all of them just packed in there.

Then we all heard the word that Ken Murray was looking for somebody to go in the Black-outs. I had no idea that I would ever get--Benny Carter would give his right arm--everybody was trying for it. The guy that was playing along with me was Wingy Manone.
Wingy Manone was playing opposite you?
